title: Getting Started
content:
Getting Started# Welcome to the ownscale documentation.
ownscale is a self-hosted control plane for Tailscale/Headscale. This section will grow to cover installation, configuration, and day-to-day operation.
Next steps# Add more pages under content/docs/. Rebuild this site with make docs from the repository root whenever you change content, then commit the regenerated etc/caddy/site/ output.
